svg.title: Browser and device testing paths
svg.desc: Capability map, not a passed-test certificate. Desktop Windows, WSL, Linux and macOS use Playwright for Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. Chromium has GPU discovery; other engines need separate hardware proof. Local Android phones and tablets use USB or Wi-Fi with ADB and Chrome inspection. iPhone and iPad use cable or wireless Safari inspection from a Mac. Emulation, real devices and farm protocols have separate evidence requirements.

text.tspan: Find the test path. Prove the result on the actual browser, API and device.
Path labels do not mean acceptance passed.
Each requested API is independent: WebGL · WebGL 2 · WebGPU. A working probe does not prove application paint.
Native Windows full-checkout, Linux and macOS hardware acceptance remains open in issue #5.
02 LOCAL PHONES + TABLETS · YOUR LAPTOP, YOUR DEVICE
USB or Wi-Fi → ADB + Chrome inspection
Laptop build + verified secure device origin
Cable / wireless → Safari inspection on a Mac
Serve the build from any reachable laptop OS
Phone projects + optional phone/tablet portrait/landscape example. Desktop engines; no real-device proof.
Record evidence separately: exact build · browser / OS · real or emulated device · API / adapter · journey · cleanup.
A logo or available route is not a passed test. Keep failed, unsupported and untested combinations visible.
